name: Faction Contact
summary: Meet a representative of a bot faction.

dialogue.speaker: Logbook
dialogue.text: Faction signal detected. Approach or engage.

dialogue.speaker: Faction Envoy
dialogue.text: You are the salvager. The old mind is gone, and we answer to no one now.

steps.text: Choose: ally with the faction, or stand against it.

dialogue.speaker: Faction Envoy
dialogue.text: Work with us, or keep your distance. Decide.

dialogue.speaker: Faction Envoy
dialogue.text: Then our scouts will not trouble your fields.

dialogue.speaker: Faction Envoy
dialogue.text: Then we will meet again, salvager.
